watch.name: maya-conversation-lapsed
watch.nl_query: Maya and I message each other often — tell me if we go quiet for a fortnight.

nodes.comment: This person was merged part-way through the month, so the same human is named by two ids across these documents. The runtime re-canonicalizes at comparison time; without that, the pre-merge message matches nothing and never reaches the wait.

Heartbeat keyed on the person. Her second message lands inside the countdown the first one started, so the re-arm resets it rather than opening a second instance — and it only lands on that instance because the two messages carry different person ids for the same human, re-canonicalized to one key at comparison time.
